invariants.rationale: Method access on element is performed without null check, so it must be non-null.
map is used as a parameter to loadLayer, so it must not be null.
parentLayers is used to add groupLayer, so it must not be null.
Explicit equivalence of equals checks for element name for logical directionality.
If the element is a group, then a groupLayer is added to parentLayers, so the count increases (assuming it was initially empty or increases by at least one).
